title: The Clock
label: ch:mr-ghadyal
canDo: I can ask what time it is, say what time it is, and say that something happens at a given hour.

payoff.summary: From cold: ask the time, tell it with the verb that counts, and place an event at an hour with the form that never changes.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. It adds NO new numbers: all twelve cardinals were already taught and had nothing to do but count.
